overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（6 篇）、收入分配与福利（2 篇）、银行与信贷（2 篇）。方法上以实验方法、因果推断为主。来源分布：arXiv（6 篇）、OpenAlex（2 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 3 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Pengaruh Intellectual Capital dan Leverage Terhadap Tax Planning Pada Perusahaan Teknologi yang Terdaftar di Bursa Efek Indonesia Periode 2020-2024
papers.abstract: Tujuan penelitian ini ialah menganalisis pengaruh intellectual capital dan leverage terhadap tax planning. Populasi mencakup perusahaan sektor teknologi yang tercatat di Bursa Efek Indonesia pada rentang waktu 2020-2024. Data penelitian bersumber dari data sekunder yang diperoleh melalui laporan keuangan perusahaan.  Melalui penerapan metode purposive sampling, terpilih 21 perusahaan sebagai sampel sehingga diperoleh 105 observasi. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan regresi linier berganda dengan bantuan aplikasi EViews versi 12. Hasil temuan menunjukkan bahwa intellectual capital memberikan pengaruh negatif yang siginifikan terhadap tax planning dengan nilai pair value sebesar 0,001. Semakin tinggi intellectual capital, semakin efektif tax planning, yang ditunjukkan oleh penurunan tingkat effective tax rate yang megindikasikan kemampuan perusahaan mengelola beban pajak. Hasil temuan ini juga mengindikasikan bahwa leverage memiliki pengaruh negatif yang siginifikan terhadap tax planning dengan nilai pair value sebesar 0,016. Semakin tinggi leverage, semakin meningkat manfaat pajak dari beban bunga, yang mengakibatkan penghasilan kena pajak berkurang dan efisiensi pembayaran pajak meningkat. Secara simultan, baik intellectual capital maupun leverage berpengaruh terhadap tax planning dengan nilai pair value sebesar 0,007. Adapun koefisien determinasi yang diperoleh sebesar 15,27 persen, sedangkan sisanya dijelaskan oleh variabel lain di luar cakupan penelitian.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究旨在分析智力资本（intellectual capital）和杠杆率（leverage）对税收筹划（tax planning）的影响。研究对象为2020至2024年间在印度尼西亚证券交易所上市的技术行业企业。研究数据来源于这些企业的财务报告。通过目的性抽样（purposive sampling）方法，共选取21家企业作为样本，共计获得105个观测值。数据分析采用EViews 12软件中的多元线性回归（multiple linear regression）模型进行。研究结果表明：智力资本对税收筹划具有显著的负面影响，其pair value为-0.001。智力资本水平越高，企业的税收筹划效果越佳，这体现在有效税率（effective tax rate）的下降上，表明企业具备较强的税收管理能力。此外，杠杆率也对税收筹划具有显著负面影响，其pair value为-0.016。杠杆率越高，企业通过利息支出获得的税收优惠越大，从而导致应纳税所得额减少，税收支付效率提升。同时，智力资本和杠杆率都对税收筹划产生影响，其pair value为-0.007。模型的决定系数（determinat...。

papers.title: Optimización financiera del presupuesto de marketing: un enfoque de administración cuantitativa para la maximización de utilidades empresariales
papers.abstract: Un adecuado aprovechamiento del presupuesto asignado al marketing contribuye a mejorar los resultados y la gestión empresarial. Este estudio tuvo como objetivo analizar la optimización financiera del presupuesto de marketing desde un enfoque de administración cuantitativa para maximizar la utilidad empresarial. Se empleó un diseño cuantitativo, descriptivo, no experimental y transversal. La población estuvo conformada por 122 estudiantes de la carrera de Administración de Empresas, seleccionados mediante un muestreo no probabilístico por conveniencia. La recolección de datos se realizó con un cuestionario de 24 ítems en escala Likert. Para el análisis se aplicó estadística descriptiva y el coeficiente Rho de Spearman, luego de comprobar la no normalidad de los datos. El instrumento presentó una adecuada fiabilidad interna con un alfa de Cronbach entre 0,818 y 0,851. Los resultados evidenciaron correlaciones positivas y significativas entre la optimización financiera del presupuesto de marketing y la maximización de la utilidad empresarial (ρ = 0,810), la distribución eficiente del presupuesto (ρ = 0,801) y el fortalecimiento a la toma de decisiones financieras (ρ = 0,830). Se concluye que una administración eficiente del presupuesto de marketing favorece la rentabilidad, optimiza la asignación de recursos, fortalece la gestión, incrementando la competitividad y sostenibilidad de la empresa.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】对市场营销预算的合理利用有助于提升企业绩效和管理水平。本研究旨在从定量管理角度分析市场营销预算的财务优化方案，以最大化企业效益。研究采用定量、描述性、非实验性的横断面研究设计，研究对象为122名工商管理专业的学生，这些学生通过方便抽样方法选取。数据收集通过包含24个李克特量表题目的问卷完成。在确认数据非正态性后，研究运用描述性统计方法和斯皮尔曼等级相关系数（Rho）进行分析。该问卷的内部信度系数（Cronbach's alpha）介于0.818至0.851之间，表明其测量工具具有较高的可靠性。研究结果表明：市场营销预算的财务优化与企业效益最大化（ρ = 0.810）、预算分配的合理性（ρ = 0.801）以及决策能力的提升（ρ = 0.830）之间存在显著的正相关关系。由此可见，有效管理市场营销预算能够提升企业盈利能力，优化资源配置，强化企业管理，从而增强企业的竞争力和可持续性。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: CausalForge: A Formally Grounded, Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Automated Research in Causal Inference
papers.abstract: Automating theoretical research is constrained not only by the generation of candidate results, but also by their reliable evaluation. A common approach is to close the research loop with a large language model (LLM) reviewer. However, such reviewers remain empirically unreliable: they may accept fabricated papers and detect them at rates close to chance (Bad Scientist, 2025). We present CausalForge, a framework for automated theoretical research in causal inference grounded in the Lean proof assistant. CausalForge combines Causalean, a foundational Lean library for causal inference containing 7,035 machine-checked declarations developed with language-model assistance under human design and review, with CausalSmith, a self-improving agentic pipeline that selects research topics, proposes results, formalizes statements, constructs proofs, and presents the resulting artifacts for human inspection. Because a machine-checked proof establishes only that a formal statement follows from its assumptions, not that the statement faithfully captures the intended scientific claim, the pipeline augments kernel verification with a statement audit that compares each formal theorem against the informal claim it is intended to express. We evaluate the system using artifacts produced by completed autonomous research runs. The source code, formal library, and run records are available at https://github.com/Jiyuan-Tan/CausalForge.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】自动化理论研究的进展不仅受到候选结果生成的制约，还受到这些结果可靠评估的阻碍。一种常见的方法是利用大型语言模型（LLM）作为评审工具来完善研究流程。然而，这类评审工具在实践中的可靠性仍存疑：它们可能会接受伪造的论文，或者以接近随机水平的准确率识别出伪造论文（Bad Scientist, 2025）。我们提出了CausalForge，这是一个基于精益证明辅助工具（Lean proof assistant）的自动化理论研究框架，专门用于因果推断领域。CausalForge整合了Causalean——这是一个用于因果推断的基础性精益库，其中包含了7,035个经过机器验证的命题，这些命题是在人类设计和审查的指导下，借助语言模型辅助生成的；同时，它还结合了CausalSmith这一自我优化的自动化流程，该流程能够选择研究主题、提出研究结果、形式化研究陈述、构建证明，并将最终生成的成果呈现给人类进行审查。由于机器验证仅能确认某个形式化命题是否从其假设中得出，并不能保证该命题能够准确反映其背后的科学主张，因此CausalForge在核心验证机制的基础上增加了声明审核功能，将每个形式化定理与其旨...。研究方法：因果推断、大语言模型。

papers.title: Settlement Infrastructure, Inside Money Elasticity, and the Network Economics of Distributed Ledger Technology
papers.abstract: We construct the Settlement Modernisation Index, a panel dataset of 809 reform events across 24 advanced economies between 1993 and 2024, decomposed into three economic channels and three adoption phases. We document an S-curve in inside money elasticity with two interior turning points at SMI = 0.27 and 0.93, separating a liberation phase, a post-global-financial-crisis compliance valley, and a mature-infrastructure recovery phase. We show that settlement modernisation generates network-conditional balance sheet efficiencies through a T2S event-study with year-by-year EMIR decomposition (saturation beta = +0.557, p < 0.01) and an out-of-sample synthetic control null on Switzerland's post-2021 SDX deployment. Applied along the BIS three-layer connectivity taxonomy, the framework forecasts +13.4 percent efficiency recovery from the ECB's Pontes initiative over 2027-2032. Conditional UK and US accession to the Appia composability layer (2028) raises the ceiling to +37.5 percent. Balance-sheet efficiencies from atomic settlement are a property of the bilateral pair, not the node.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们构建了“结算现代化指数”（Settlement Modernisation Index），该指数包含1993年至2024年间24个发达经济体中发生的809项改革事件，这些数据被分解为三个经济渠道和三个采纳阶段。研究发现，货币内部流动性的弹性呈现出S型曲线，其中有两个转折点，分别为SMI = 0.27和SMI = 0.93；这两个转折点将整个过程划分为三个阶段：解放阶段、全球金融危机后的合规调整阶段，以及基础设施成熟后的恢复阶段。通过T2S（交易对手方直接结算，Trade-to-Counterparty Settlement）事件研究以及逐年细分的EMIR（欧洲支付指令，European Payment Instruction）数据，我们证实结算现代化能够提升资产负债表效率（饱和效应β值为+0.557，p < 0.01）；同时，通过对瑞士2021年后实施的SDX（安全直接结算，Secure Direct Settlement）项目进行样本外合成控制分析，也验证了这一效应。根据国际清算银行（BIS）的三层连通性分类体系，该框架预测在2027至2032年间，由于欧洲中央银行（ECB...。研究方法：合成控制法、面板数据。

papers.title: Can Green Public Procurement Drive Corporate Breakthrough Green Innovation? Evidence From Green Patent Textual Analysis
papers.abstract: This study examines the effect of green public procurement (GPP) on corporate breakthrough green innovation. We construct a novel measure of breakthrough innovation by applying advanced natural language processing models (i.e., SBERT and PatentSBERTa) to the textual similarity of green patent networks. Using a comprehensive panel of Chinese listed firms from 2015 to 2023, we find that GPP significantly catalyses breakthrough green innovation, with the magnitude of the effect increasing with procurement intensity. We identify two primary mechanisms: an external financing channel, where GPP alleviates financial constraints via credit generating effect, and an internal green governance channel, where government demand improves corporate governance through green demand effect. Cross‐sectional tests show the effect is more pronounced in firms receiving higher media attention and in regions with stronger intellectual property rights and stricter environmental regulation. Furthermore, we document significant positive spillovers along both industrial and supply chains. Our results are robust to local projection models, propensity score matching, instrumental variable estimation, omitted variable tests, and double machine learning method. Collectively, these findings highlight the pivotal role of demand‐side policy tools in shaping high‐quality corporate green innovation.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】本研究探讨了绿色公共采购（GPP）对企业突破性绿色创新的影响。我们通过应用先进的自然语言处理模型（如SBERT和PatentSBERTa）来分析绿色专利网络中的文本相似性，从而构建了一种衡量突破性创新的新方法。利用2015年至2023年间中国上市公司的全面数据集，我们发现绿色公共采购显著促进了企业的突破性绿色创新，且这种影响的强度随着采购力度的增加而增强。我们确定了两种主要机制：一是外部融资渠道，即绿色公共采购通过产生信用效应缓解企业的财务约束；二是内部绿色治理机制，即政府需求通过绿色需求效应改善企业的治理结构。横截面分析表明，这种效应在受到更多媒体关注的企业以及知识产权保护更强、环境监管更严格的地区更为显著。此外，我们还观察到这种影响在产业链上下游都存在显著的正向溢出效应。我们的研究结果在经过多种方法验证后依然稳健，包括局部投影模型、倾向得分匹配、工具变量估计、遗漏变量检验以及双重机器学习方法等。总体而言，这些发现凸显了需求侧政策工具在推动高质量企业绿色创新方面的重要作用。。研究方法：工具变量、倾向得分匹配、局部投影法、机器学习。

papers.title: Child penalty in developing countries: evidence from Vietnam
papers.venue: Journal of Economics Finance and Administrative Science
papers.abstract:
This paper investigates the effects of childbirth on female employment in Vietnam from 1989 to 2019.
 
 
 
 Using Vietnam census data from 1989 to 2019, this study constructs a pseudo-event panel by matching parents at different stages of the parenting lifecycle with demographically similar counterparts without children.
 
 
 
 The results show a sharp and persistent decline in female employment following childbirth, with no comparable effect on men. This paper further documents significant variations in the magnitude of the child penalty across regions and over time and finds that women who are married, live in urban areas, belong to the ethnic majority, are more educated or have migrated face a significantly greater child penalty. In contrast, women who co-reside with their child's grandparents or work in agriculture or the public sector appear to have a lower child penalty.
 
 
 
 This study is among the few to measure and analyze the child penalty in a developing country. In particular, it provides the first systematic province-level analysis of the child penalty in Vietnam. Moreover, this study has policy implications for a developing country during a period of economic transformation amid rising gender inequality.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】本文研究了1989年至2019年间生育对越南女性就业的影响。

利用1989年至2019年的越南人口普查数据，本研究通过将处于不同育儿阶段的父母与没有子女的、在人口统计特征上相似的对照组进行匹配，构建了一个伪事件面板。

研究结果表明，生育后女性就业率出现了显著且持续的下降，而男性就业率并未出现类似的变化。此外，研究还发现生育对女性就业的负面影响在不同地区和不同时间存在显著差异：已婚女性、居住在城市地区的女性、属于多数族裔的女性、受教育程度较高的女性以及迁移过的女性所面临的生育惩罚更为严重。相比之下，与子女的祖父母共同生活的女性、从事农业工作或公共部门工作的女性所面临的生育惩罚相对较低。

本研究是少数能够衡量和分析发展中国家生育对女性就业影响的研究之一。特别是，它首次对越南各省份的生育惩罚现象进行了系统的分析。此外，鉴于当前发展中国家正处于经济转型期且性别不平等问题日益严重，本研究具有重要的政策启示意义。。

papers.title: Global Pension Asset Allocations and Debt Markets
papers.abstract: The pension sector is an important investor group in global financial markets and a key holder of government and corporate debt. This article examines the evolution of pension fund asset allocations around the globe and documents two important structural changes. First, pension investors have shifted portfolio share allocations away from fixed income securities. This trend is robust across Defined Contribution (DC) and Defined Benefit (DB) programs as well as country groups. Second, pensions have instead shifted allocations into riskier investments within mutual funds as well as alternative investments. We hypothesize that a global decline in interest rates is one potential driver of this change. Using a global sample, we show that declining local currency government bond yields are associated with lower bond pension portfolio shares and higher holdings shares of mutual funds and foreign assets. We discuss the potential implications of these trends for borrowing costs. The declining holding share of pensions as a long-term investor group implies financing costs are less sensitive to new debt issues, but more sensitive to global uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文旨在考察全球养老金资产配置的演变，并分析其结构性变化对债务市场及借贷成本的影响。

🔬 研究方法：文章利用全球样本数据，实证检验了利率下降与养老金资产配置变化之间的因果关系。

📊 核心发现：研究发现养老金投资者正在减少固定收益证券的配置，转而增加共同基金和另类投资；当地政府债券收益率的下降与这种资产配置的转移显著相关。

💡 应用价值：这些趋势表明，随着养老金作为长期投资者份额的下降，融资成本对全球不确定性的敏感度增加，而对新债务发行的敏感度降低。

papers.title: Self-Fulfilling Credit Scores
papers.abstract: A decline in credit scores can worsen the borrower's financial position, making default a self-fulfilling prophecy. We estimate the causal effect of credit scores on default using a rule that counts multiple inquiries within 14 days as one, moving scores without changing credit reports. Regression discontinuity estimates around the 14-day cut-off show that an additional counted inquiry lowers scores by five points on average. Default does not respond among consumers with clean records, but rises by 3.2 percentage points over two years among those with prior derogatories. For these consumers, at least 13 percent of the relationship between scores and default is self-fulfilling. We show that scorers would want to limit self-fulfilling defaults if their objective is forecast accuracy, but not if it is separating defaulters from non-defaulters, because that objective rewards the score for the defaults it causes.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】信用评分的下降会恶化借款人的财务状况，从而使违约成为一种自我实现的预言。我们通过一种规则来估计信用评分对违约的因果影响：该规则将14天内的多次信用查询视为一次查询，并在更新信用报告的同时调整评分。在14天这一分界点附近的回归分析结果显示，每次额外被计量的信用查询平均会使评分降低5分。对于信用记录良好的消费者而言，违约行为并未发生变化；而对于那些此前有过信用不良记录的消费者来说，违约率在两年内上升了3.2个百分点。对于这些消费者而言，评分与违约之间的关系至少有13%是自我实现的（即评分的变化导致了违约行为的进一步发生）。我们发现，如果评分机构的目标是提高预测准确性，那么他们应该限制这种自我实现的违约现象；但如果目标是将违约者与非违约者区分开来，那么这种自我实现的机制反而会对评分机构有利，因为这会使得那些导致违约的评分显得更加“可靠”。。研究方法：断点回归、回归分析。

papers.title: Nonlinear Boosting with Multiple Testing in High-Dimensional Generalised Linear Models with Binary Responses
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a nonlinear boosting with multiple testing (BMT) approach to variable selection in high-dimensional generalised linear models with binary responses. At each stage of the BMT procedure, the model is updated by adding only the most significant covariate, conditional on those already selected in previous stages, while taking into account the multiple testing nature of the problem. It is shown that, under the stated conditions, the BMT procedure selects all covariates whose true coefficients are nonzero, and no other covariates, with probability tending to one. Furthermore, the procedure enjoys an oracle property, in the sense that the post-BMT maximum likelihood estimator of the parameters of the model is asymptotically equivalent to an oracle estimator that knows the correct sparse model in advance. Monte Carlo experiments demonstrate that BMT outperforms competing methods, delivering high covariate-selection accuracy and low parameter estimation error. An empirical example illustrates that BMT delivers a predictive model for the probability that U.S. inflation exceeds a given threshold over a 12-month horizon which has very good out-of-sample performance.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文提出了一种基于非线性提升算法与多重检验（BMT）的变量选择方法，适用于具有二元响应的高维广义线性模型。在BMT过程的每个阶段，模型仅通过添加在先前阶段已被选中的协变量中最为显著的那个协变量来进行更新，同时考虑到了问题的多重检验特性。研究表明，在给定条件下，BMT过程能够以概率趋近于1的方式选择所有真实系数非零的协变量，而不会选择其他任何协变量。此外，该过程具有“神谕性质”：即BMT后的模型参数最大似然估计量在渐近意义上等同于一个事先已知正确稀疏模型的“神谕估计量”。蒙特卡洛实验表明，BMT在变量选择精度和参数估计误差方面均优于其他竞争方法。一个实证案例展示了BMT能够构建出一个预测模型，用于预测美国通胀率在12个月期限内超过某一阈值的概率，该模型的样本外预测性能非常出色。。研究方法：最大似然估计、蒙特卡洛模拟、实验方法。

papers.title: Latent Fragility and Clustered Withdrawals in Dynamic Banks Runs
papers.abstract: Using a mean-field game framework, we study a dynamic model of bank runs in which more withdrawals raise the risk of bank failure. Even though depositors receive gradual and idiosyncratic shocks, withdrawals occur in clusters. The main mechanism is latent fragility: run-prone depositors accumulate gradually over time and may prefer to wait individually, but they withdraw together once collective exit becomes self-fulfilling. We establish equilibrium existence and characterize earliest-run and latest-run equilibria. The clustering mechanism arises whether depositor heterogeneity is discrete or continuous. A common aggregate state coordinates withdrawal timing and leads to a unique threshold equilibrium.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】我们采用平均场博弈框架，研究了一种银行挤兑的动态模型。在该模型中，更多的取款行为会增加银行倒闭的风险。尽管储户面临的冲击是渐进且具有个体差异性的，但取款行为仍以群体形式发生。这一现象的主要机制在于潜在的脆弱性：容易发生挤兑的储户会逐渐积累，他们可能最初选择单独等待，但一旦集体撤离的行为成为自我实现的预言，他们就会同时行动。我们证明了均衡的存在性，并描述了最早发生挤兑和最晚发生挤兑的均衡状态。无论储户的异质性是离散的还是连续的，这种群体聚集现象都会出现。一个共同的总体状态会协调所有储户的取款时机，从而形成一个唯一的阈值均衡。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Measuring inequality and social stratification with Lorenz curvature
papers.abstract: We construct a continuous family of inequality and social stratification indices based on the curvature of the Lorenz curve. We study the inequality axioms of the family and find that they are satisfied only with the so-called stratification-aversion parameter $α$ set to 0 -- in all other cases, these constraints cannot be satisfied in a strict sense. With $α= 0$, the index has a very simple closed form and its value can be easily approximated. We study the values of the index on World Bank inequality data and see how the rankings across a wide selection of countries change as $α$ is varied. Spearman and Kendall rank-correlation matrices with other common indices are also computed and analyzed. We find the curvature index to deviate consistently from the comparison indices, albeit less so for consumption- than income-based countries.
papers.summary_zh: 【收入分配与福利】我们基于洛伦兹曲线的曲率构建了一系列连续的不平等与社会分层指数。我们研究了该指数族的不平等公理，发现只有在所谓的分层厌恶参数α设为0的情况下这些公理才能得到满足；在其他所有情况下，这些约束都无法严格得到满足。当α=0时，该指数具有非常简单的封闭形式，其数值可以很容易地被近似计算出来。我们利用世界银行的不平等数据研究了该指数的数值，并观察了随着α的变化，众多国家之间的排名如何发生变化。同时，我们还计算并分析了斯皮尔曼（Spearman）和肯德尔（Kendall）等级相关矩阵与其他常见指数之间的差异。研究发现，该曲率指数与各种比较指数之间存在持续性的偏差，尽管这种偏差在基于消费指标的国家中表现得不如基于收入指标的国家那么明显。。

papers.title: Neilson's Weak vs. Strong Loss Aversion: A Characterization and a Generalized CPT-Utility Function
papers.abstract: In multi-objective and multi-criteria decision-making under risk, especially in settings involving individual behavior, risk-aware analysis based on subjective evaluation has become increasingly important. Moving beyond risk-neutral modeling and the constraints of Expected Utility Theory (EUT), Cumulative Prospect Theory (CPT) provides a behaviorally grounded framework for capturing how individuals perceive and evaluate risky prospects. This paper conducts a rigorous theoretical analysis of Neilson's definitions of aversion. We provide a gamble-based interpretation, sharpen key conceptual distinctions, and make explicit the conditions under which the weak and strong notions coincide as well as when they diverge. Furthermore, we examine the Kobberling-Wakker utility function and related standard CPT specifications, highlighting structural limitations and inconsistencies that arise when these forms are required to satisfy Neilson-type aversion conditions. To address these issues, we propose a generalized CPT-utility function that retains the canonical reference-dependent shape while offering additional flexibility. This generalization extends the descriptive scope of CPT and provides an explicit functional form that is useful for sensitivity analysis and utility function-based optimization.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在涉及风险的多目标多标准决策中，尤其是在涉及个体行为的情境下，基于主观评估的风险意识分析变得越来越重要。累积前景理论（Cumulative Prospect Theory, CPT）突破了风险中性建模和期望效用理论（Expected Utility Theory, EUT）的局限性，提供了一个基于行为学的框架，用于理解个体如何感知和评估风险情境。本文对Neilson关于风险厌恶（aversion）的定义进行了严谨的理论分析，提出了基于赌博行为的解释，明确了关键概念之间的区别，并阐明了弱形式与强形式风险厌恶概念一致或出现分歧的条件。此外，我们还研究了Kobberling-Wakker效用函数及相关标准CPT模型，指出了这些模型在试图满足Neilson类型风险厌恶条件时所存在的结构局限性和矛盾之处。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种广义的CPT效用函数，该函数在保持典型参考依赖性（reference dependence）特征的同时，提供了更大的灵活性。这一推广不仅扩展了CPT的描述范围，还为敏感性分析和基于效用函数的优化提供了明确的函数形式。。研究方法：优化方法。
